name: Craft Psicrown [Psionic] [Item Creation]
body:
You can create psicrowns, stores of versatile and immense psionic power.

Prerequisite(s): Manifester level 11th

Benefit(s): You can create any psicrown whose prerequisites you meet. Crafting a psicrown takes one day for each 1,000 gp in its base price.
